scope: Static client search for a fixedPhrase selection-to-wire encoder or wire-to-fixedPhrase decoder. Map and World chat paths were investigated separately. The retained retail capture corpus is closed; no new retail-service evidence is expected.
verdict: The available static evidence does not connect a fixedPhrase row lookup to a chat byte encoder or decoder. No token framing, tag byte, length rule, field order, ID width, byte order, escaping rule, row-key serialization, category serialization, malformed-token behavior, or forwarding behavior is established. Implementing a decoder from the candidate constants below would be speculative.

map_chain: FUN_006E91F0 branches on five string keys and reaches FUN_0075BEF0, FUN_0075BFD0, or FUN_0075C0B0.
The three wrappers call FUN_004D8160 at VAs 0x0075BFA0, 0x0075C080, and 0x0075C160 with context markers 1, 2, and 0x19.
FUN_004D8160 casts Application::Main::RaptureElement to Application::Main::Element::RelativeElement through FUN_009DA6CC, prepares caller-owned state, and calls FUN_004E0320 at VA 0x004D8279.

FUN_004E0320 is the sole Map c2s 0x0003 emitter. It writes opcode 0x0003 and record size 0x230, copies a caller-supplied 0x200-byte source buffer through FUN_00447BC0, FUN_004451F0, FUN_00445210, and FUN_009D4600, then sends through FUN_00DAE010.
No fixedPhrase lookup, table identity, phrase ID, or token-byte write is present in this chain.
world_chain: FUN_004DF6D0 builds World c2s 0x00C9 at size 0x218 and sends through FUN_00DB3E30.
FUN_004DF810 calls FUN_004E3750, which builds World c2s 0x00C8 at size 0x230 before FUN_00DB3E30.
Both World paths copy caller-supplied string buffers through the same generic string begin/end helpers. Neither reaches FUN_004E0320 or a fixedPhrase lookup.

receiver_search.parser: FUN_007906C0 at VA 0x007906C0 is an 800-byte generic render-control byte-stream parser. Its direct callers are FUN_0089FBF0, FUN_0089EB40, FUN_0089E320, FUN_00790AA0, FUN_00790B20, FUN_00790A30, and FUN_00790BA0. The cases dispatch through a renderer interface, but no caller reaches a fixedPhrase table lookup.
receiver_search.fixed_phrase_path: The independent static table path is FUN_004DAA10 -> FUN_004DA680 -> FUN_00447260("xtx/_fixedPhrase", string VA 0x00F90D70) -> FUN_00C9D550. FUN_00C9D550 has null/state failure returns and branches on leading bytes 0x40 and 0x23, but no edge joins it to a Map or World chat sender, receiver, or FUN_007906C0. Those bytes are therefore not established wire tags.
receiver_search.other_negative: FUN_004D9D70 references the unrelated string "//shortcut %d <t>" at VA 0x00F90D84 and calls FUN_0056DD20. It has no fixedPhrase or chat-parser edge.

table_evidence.corpus: The authenticated xivl-client-data csv/xtx__fixedPhrase.csv has 758 data rows and SHA256 A9CE38B0B4CA33E1C03BF22BC854E054BB46DB1CEF9EDFB4E9C55C5D0516A16. Its CSV row key is stored separately from field 0. Row 974 has field 0 value 9 and localized Map text; row 1255 has field 0 value 10 and localized /map text. Neither value is joined to wire bytes.
table_evidence.category_fence: The separate xtx_logCategory table maps display-category row keys such as 1 Say, 2 Shout, 3 Tell, 4 Party, 28 Urgent Information, 29 General Information, 32 System Messages, and 33 System Error Messages. It does not prove that those row keys occur in a SendLog or chat wire field.

capture_evidence.retail_corpus: The owner-attested 1.23b retail corpus is fixed at 54 capture files. It contains two Map c2s 0x0003 messages with 576-byte sub-events in chat_say and chat_shout, and eleven World c2s 0x00C9 messages with 552-byte sub-events in party_battle_leve and war_quest_update2. The derived samples do not independently identify an auto-translate selection, CSV row, locale, or rendered phrase.

controlled_local_capture_plan.scope: Optional preserved-client test against a local server stack. It cannot replace retail evidence and must be labeled non-retail corroboration. No new retail-service capture is possible or expected.
pinning: Record hashes for the preserved client executable, local server binaries/configuration, table CSV, and capture/hook tooling.
Keep full raw packet objects and the exact command/script used to decode them.
messages: At least four independently attested fixedPhrase selections spanning low and high sparse row keys and more than one field 0/category.
For each selection, send a token-only message and a literal-token-literal message.
Repeat every message enough times to distinguish stable token bytes from counters, timestamps, and session state.
Exercise Map and World paths separately where the preserved client and local server support them.
record_per_message: exact fixedPhrase CSV row key and field 0 value selected in the UI
full raw message-field bytes before transport framing
hook_points: Map sender FUN_004E0320 and World sender FUN_004DF6D0 to snapshot caller-owned source bytes
SendLog constructor FUN_0089F5B0 and parser family cataloged by manifests/sendlog_parser_shape_refutation.json
controlled_local_capture_plan.acceptance: Promote a wire model only if raw bytes distinguish row-key serialization from field 0/category serialization, prove framing and length semantics across repeated low/high sparse rows, and reproduce literal-token-literal interleaving. A rendered-text match alone is insufficient.
